why: three analyses this session were invalidated by the same bug class -- a check reading the wrong field or covering part of a boundary, producing a plausible number that aggregates cannot detect. Before extending the analysis further, the standing claims were audited against that class. C42 was audited first because it is a stop-condition artifact: objectives 3 and 4 rest on it.

audit_1_the_C42_support_gap_population.exposure: the C37/C42 support test compares a per-SLOT HP delta, which is meaningless when the active changed. 76 of the 309 structural rows have a switch on the complaining slot, so the exposure is real and large.
audit_1_the_C42_support_gap_population.method: re-ran the support test with slot_hp_comparable guarding every verdict
audit_1_the_C42_support_gap_population.verdict: CLEAN. None of the 50 confirmed support gaps sits on a switched slot. The C42 adjudication, and with it the objective-3 and objective-4 evidence, survives the bug class unchanged.
audit_1_the_C42_support_gap_population.why_it_escaped: the support test runs on the D-with-count-evidence subset, not the full structural population. The 76 switch rows are all outside that subset. That is luck rather than design -- the test had no guard and would have been wrong if they had fallen inside.

what_this_audit_does_not_cover: the other standing claims -- the 203 count-mismatch-only rows, the 70 majority-arm disagreements from C61, and the 82 same-Pokemon-different-HP rows -- are not yet audited against this bug class. C61's population was defined with an explicit switch check so it is probably sound; the 203 came from miss-string parsing and involves no HP arithmetic, so it is probably immune. Neither has been verified and 'probably' is what produced the three bugs.
the_durable_fix_already_landed: scripts/switch_safe_hp.py returns None rather than 0 for an uncomparable slot, so a future analysis that forgets the case raises instead of publishing. This audit used it, which is the first time the guard has been applied to an existing claim rather than a new one.
does_not_reach_a_pass: no code changed; unattributed stays at 341
